owner_confirmed_choices: DynamoDB operational records and private encrypted S3 originals
One controlled backend financial writer; agents draft and owner confirms exact payload
GBP portfolio presentation with local detail
CSV, Excel, PDF, screenshot and manual inputs in v1; sample-backed supported layouts
Portfolio-risk priority; peak drawdown and cost-basis loss separately
Calendar-month anniversaries roll to preceding valid local session/valuation date; score on canonical availability

decisions.proposal: Propose 28 significant and 12 fractional digits for money/quantity/price, 16 fractional for FX, 50 working digits, half-even presentation and exact source reconciliation. Record calculated allocation residuals explicitly.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Reject unsupported precision with field evidence; qualify instrument/source bounds before freezing.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose 15 minutes with strict server_now < expires_at and sensitive-action assurance. Permit a logically consistent explicit subset only with a new hash and disclosed exclusions. Define expiry at trusted-writer transaction submission; completion can occur later because DynamoDB has no server-clock condition. Strict completion-before-expiry needs a different proved control.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Drafting can continue; activation requires an agreed expiry, assurance and subset policy.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose trade-date exposure with receivable/payable until supported settlement, nonadditive observations and an owner-confirmed backfill cutover generation.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Never guess settlement. Unsupported negative/margin positions and material reconciliation conflicts block affected metrics.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose bounded (-0.999999,100] search, uniqueness certificate or abstention, rate tolerance 1e-10 and NPV tolerance max(1e-8 currency units,1e-12×sum absolute flows). Measure a finite resource budget before implementation.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: No headline rate under ambiguity or nonconvergence. A grid cannot certify full-domain uniqueness.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Use source-supported basis first; analytical FIFO only after approval, labelled separately from tax basis. Choose per-market/kind benchmark mapping, TR convention, fees, flow timing and missing-session policy.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Basis gain or benchmark may remain unavailable without blocking independently supported valuation.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Propose 126 common return sessions, minimum 100 valid observations and a 252-session sensitivity; no zero fill and a common complete covariance matrix. Price/NAV/FX age limits join the data specification.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Coverage and close-time alignment need evidence. No full-risk claim from partial holdings or arbitrary covariance repair.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.proposal: Keep owner weights 35/40/25. Propose all three components required and normalization to [0,100] only after evaluation. No action threshold is selected.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Do not classify an action until normalization, tie handling and thresholds have evidence and owner agreement.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.

decisions.topic: Audit integrity, retention, export expiry and physical design
decisions.proposal: Agree financial/audit/approval/idempotency retention and private export expiry; choose independently protected integrity anchors and restore-erasure proof. Prove access patterns and costs before DDB key/index selection.
decisions.consequence_if_unresolved: Cannot certify tamper resistance or complete original availability; build waits for visibility/recovery proof.
decisions.evidence_needed: Worked cases, targeted offline correctness/spike evidence and owner agreement; not approval by this specification.
